scenes.title: Cosmology and table conversation
scenes.rationale: Opening discussion is out of character and does not belong inside the campfire action.
scenes.overview: The table discusses planes, souls and possible approaches to planar play.
scenes.transitionToNext: The DM resumes play at the Karawa campfire.

scenes.title: Questions around the campfire
scenes.rationale: A continuous evening conversation explores the companions’ purposes and magical questions.
scenes.overview: The companions discuss Shakun, Candrosa, their motives, the mirror and Kenzo’s jade.

scenes.title: Preparing for the desert
scenes.rationale: Havdar’s briefing, final preparations and departure form one expedition-launch sequence, including the uneventful approach to Bas Udda.
scenes.overview: Plan with Havdar, store supplies, attend to private business and ride toward Bas Udda.
scenes.transitionToNext: The expedition reaches the ruined town and finds circling vultures.

scenes.title: Vultures over Bas Udda
scenes.rationale: The investigation of the ruined town and the vulture attack are one immediate encounter.
scenes.overview: Assess the devastation and fight the giant vultures outside the temple.
scenes.transitionToNext: With the birds driven off, the party enters the temple and speaks with Amil.

scenes.title: Amil and the funeral pyres
scenes.rationale: Meeting Amil, learning about his masters and helping with the dead form one sustained situation.
scenes.overview: Hear of the rescued elf, help lay the dead to rest and arrange to escort Amil home.
scenes.transitionToNext: After the overnight stay, final checks give way to departure with Amil.

scenes.title: The road to the spring
scenes.rationale: Departure, travel and scouting establish the new canyon situation before hostilities begin.
scenes.overview: Leave Bas Udda, travel with Amil and discover ogres at the spring.
scenes.transitionToNext: Wellby’s request for passage turns into a chase.

scenes.title: Ogres in the canyon
scenes.rationale: The three tactical beats are one continuous fight against the same ogres.
scenes.overview: Fight three ogres using the canyon ledges, heated chain and earthen barrier.
scenes.transitionToNext: The last ogre falls, allowing the party to recover Amil and continue.

scenes.title: The stone house
scenes.rationale: Post-combat recovery and arrival at the masters’ home form the closing scene.
scenes.overview: Retrieve Amil and reach the house, where one of his masters recognizes Delwath.
